record.hypothesis: Replace BPR with softplus(neg_score-pos_score) plus 0.2 times [softplus(-pos_score)+softplus(neg_score)], averaged over the existing nonpadding targets. The pairwise term preserves ranking pressure while the pointwise terms constrain score drift and give both observed and sampled items direct supervision. Keep the exact samples, GRU, embeddings, readout, optimizer, scheduler and training limits unchanged. Retain one checkpoint per category.
record.diff_excerpt:
--- 
+++ 
@@ -156,5 +156,10 @@
     pos_scores, neg_scores = model(seq, pos, neg)
     mask = (pos != 0).float()
-    loss = -torch.log(torch.sigmoid(pos_scores - neg_scores) + 1e-8)
+    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores - pos_scores)
+    pointwise_loss = (
+        torch.nn.functional.softplus(-pos_scores)
+        + torch.nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores)
+    )
+    loss = pairwise_loss + 0.2 * pointwise_loss
     return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
